study.title: Deep Learning for Weed Detection and Segmentation in Agricultural Crops Using Images Captured by an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
study.short_title: YOLOv8 vs Mask R-CNN vs U-Net weed seg (Bean Soy UAV set)

segmentation.domain: weed detection and segmentation in soybean and common bean crops (instance segmentation via YOLOv8/YOLOv7/YOLOv5s/Mask R-CNN, plus U-Net semantic segmentation from generated green-to-white masks)
segmentation.best_model: YOLOv8s: mAP50 0.970, mAP50:95 0.968, precision 0.997, recall 0.990, F1-score 0.964 (500 epochs); best Mask R-CNN backbone R101-DC5 with AP50 0.965; U-Net valid pixel accuracy 0.961 (100 epochs)

dataset.name: "Bean Soy Dataset" (self-collected; soybean Glycine max and common bean Phaseolus vulgaris, Ceres, Goias, Brazil)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 3 Standard RGB camera (text states Full HD 1980x1080; Table 3 lists original 4000x3000). 793 originals collected Dec 2022-Feb 2023, augmented to 3021 (2270 train / 370 val / 381 test, 75/12/13%); fields 20 m altitude, GSD 8.8 mm/px, frontal/side overlap 80/72%, Pix4Dcapture 2.8.3. Roboflow polygon annotation; 16,113 instances (7,074 weeds, avg 8.92 weeds/image; 4,532 bean; 4,507 soybean). Resized to 640x640 (YOLO/Mask R-CNN) and 512x512 (U-Net); U-Net masks generated by green-to-white pixel thresholding. Training on Google Colab NVIDIA Tesla T4.

segmentation.backbone: YOLOv8/7/5s: CSPDarkNet53; Mask R-CNN (Detectron2): ResNet101-FPN, ResNet101-DC5, ResNeXt101-32x8d-FPN; U-Net encoder: ResNet50

mIoU.ambiguity: No mean IoU reported. Segmentation quality expressed only via AP at fixed IoU thresholds (AP50/AP75/AP 0.50:0.95) for Mask R-CNN and mAP50/mAP50:95 for YOLO models; U-Net evaluated with accuracy/loss only.

mPA.ambiguity: Mean pixel accuracy not reported. Pixel-level accuracy reported only for the U-Net semantic model (see PA).

F1.quote: Table 10. Accuracy scores, mAP, and F1-score of the YOLOv8s, YOLOv7, and YOLOv5s models over 500 epochs ... YOLOv8s ... F1-Score 0.964
F1.section: 3. Results / 3.1 Performance of Different Backbones and Model Variants
F1.ambiguity: Model-level F1-score of detection/segmentation for YOLOv8s (500 epochs), not per-class. YOLOv7 0.951, YOLOv5s 0.960 for comparison.

Dice.ambiguity: Dice/Sorensen not evaluated (explicitly noted in Discussion 4.2 as a metric that could be considered).

PA.quote: The training set accuracy was 97.1%, with a loss value of 0.024, while for validation, the accuracy was 96.1%, with a loss value of 0.033.
PA.section: 3. Results / 3.2 Performance of Different Training Epochs and Iterations
PA.ambiguity: U-Net (ResNet50) validation accuracy at 100 epochs interpreted as overall pixel accuracy of the semantic segmentation model; train accuracy 0.971. YOLO/Mask R-CNN 'Acc' values (0.95-0.99) are detection accuracy, not pixel accuracy.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not reported. Weed-class accuracy/mAP: YOLOv8s Acc_weed 0.980, mAP_weed 0.987; YOLOv7 Acc_weed 0.990, mAP_weed 0.990 (Table 10).

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 not reported; only weed-class accuracy/mAP columns provided (bean and soybean treated jointly).

edge.device: NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPU (Google Colaboratory); AMD Ryzen 7 6800H CPU; 16 GB RAM; Windows 10
edge.framework: PyTorch 2.1 / CUDA 12.2 (Python 3.12), Ultralytics (YOLO), Detectron2 (Mask R-CNN), U-Net; training on Google Colaboratory NVIDIA Tesla T4

fps.ambiguity: No inference-speed/latency numbers reported; Discussion 4.1 only claims qualitatively that YOLOv8s takes less detection/segmentation time than other variants.

latency_ms.ambiguity: Not reported. All training/inference on Google Colab Tesla T4 GPU; no edge/real-time deployment.

params_M.ambiguity: Model sizes (nano to large) referenced qualitatively; no parameter counts reported.

issues: Mixed-task comparative study: headline metrics are instance-segmentation mAP/precision/recall (YOLO family and Mask R-CNN) plus U-Net pixel accuracy; no genuine mean-IoU reported across models (RQ1 mIoU not reportable).
PA recorded from U-Net validation accuracy (0.961, Table 15) interpreted as overall pixel accuracy; YOLO/Mask R-CNN 'Acc' columns are detection accuracy and excluded.
F1 recorded only as the YOLOv8s model-level F1-score (0.964, Table 10); per-class weed/crop F1 unavailable.
No efficiency/latency metrics and no edge deployment; all runs on Google Colab Tesla T4 (Discussion 4.1 mentions YOLOv8s faster inference only qualitatively).
Camera resolution discrepancy: Methods text cites RGB Full HD 1980x1080, but Table 3 lists original 4000x3000; GSD derived from 20 m flight (8.8 mm/px).
